stem:
A container is shaped like a triangular prism. Each base of the container is an equilateral triangle with the dimensions shown.

The container has a height of 15 centimeters. What is the lateral surface area of the container in square centimeters?
instruction: Record your answer and fill in the bubbles on your answer document. Be sure to use the correct place value.
visual_elements: equilateral triangle with sides labeled 6 cm, 6 cm, and 6 cm
